description: Sieges_et_antennes_MSD is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by le64.fr. File of points of the seats and antennas of the MSDs. Location on the orthophotography of the IGN(2008) on the basis of an old database of the Department confronted with a list of addresses updated by the DSD and consolidated by telephone calls to headquarters or antennas. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "_ and _ seats _MSD antennas" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include MSD, Maisons de la Solidarité Départementale. The listing shows 2013-07-01 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
